name: Void Hyperion
source:
In the far future, humanity has taken to the stars and found monsters known as Voidlings. A captain of the human Empire is assigned a suicide mission to destroy the nest of a Void Queen near the Empire's borders. However, unbeknownst to her, those by her side may have different thoughts.

An omegaverse sci-fi yuri visual novel. 

[From [url=https://4noki.itch.io/void-hyperion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的未来，人类来到了星际并发现了被称为“虚灵”的怪物。人类帝国的一名队长被指派执行一项自杀式任务，摧毁帝国边境附近虚空女王的巢穴。然而，她不知道的是，她身边的人可能有不同的想法。

一部欧米伽宇宙科幻尤里视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://4noki.itch.io/void-hyperion]itch.io[/url]]
